questions.question: 1) What interaction technique allows users to select distant objects in VR?

explanations.a: Incorrect. Grab interaction is used for picking up nearby objects.
explanations.b: Incorrect. Locomotion refers to movement in VR.
explanations.c: Correct. Ray interaction allows users to point and select distant objects.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Climbing is related to movement in vertical environments.

answers.a: A technique for adjusting the lighting in VR
answers.b: A method for moving around in a virtual environment
answers.d: A way to control object scaling in 3D modeling

explanations.a: Incorrect – Lighting adjustments are separate from locomotion.
explanations.b: Correct – Locomotion allows users to navigate within a VR space.
explanations.c: Incorrect – Rendering shadows is part of graphical processing, not locomotion.
explanations.d: Incorrect – Object scaling is a modeling tool, not a movement technique.

questions.question: 3) What is the role of socket interaction in VR?

answers.a: To attach virtual objects to predefined positions
answers.b: To create lighting effects in VR
answers.d: To display UI elements on the screen

explanations.a: Correct – Socket interaction allows objects to snap to predefined positions in VR environments.
explanations.b: Incorrect – Lighting effects are separate from object interactions.
explanations.c: Incorrect – Head tracking is handled by the VR headset, not socket interaction.
explanations.d: Incorrect – UI elements are controlled separately, not through socket interaction.

questions.question: 4) What is the primary function of a VR menu UI?

answers.b: To provide users with interactive navigation and control options in VR
answers.d: To replace the need for controllers

explanations.a: Incorrect – VR UI manages in-game settings, not real-world device settings.
explanations.b: Correct – VR menus allow users to navigate options and control settings within the virtual environment
explanations.c: Incorrect – Weather simulation is separate from UI functionality.
explanations.d: Incorrect – Controllers are still required for interaction in most VR systems.

questions.question: 5) How does climbing interaction work in VR?

answers.a: By using ray interaction to point at objects
answers.b: By grabbing handholds and pulling the user upwards
answers.c: By adjusting gravity settings in the physics engine
answers.d: By increasing the field of view (FOV)

explanations.a: Incorrect – Ray interaction is used for distant object selection, not climbing.
explanations.b: Correct – Climbing mechanics allow users to grab handholds and pull themselves up in VR.
explanations.c: Incorrect – Gravity adjustments affect object physics but do not define climbing mechanics.
explanations.d: Incorrect – Field of view adjustments do not enable climbing.
